programs.title: Tesla's Death Ray: A Murder Declassified
programs.desc: The series presents the achievements of the famous inventor Nikola Tesla and conspiracy theories regarding his mysterious death.The engineer from Serbia is the author of nearly 300 patents, most of which are still used by people today.His working methods, including the experiments he performed, aroused much controversy, which made him considered an eccentric and dangerous person.When he died unexpectedly in his New York apartment in 1943, his notes on his work were allegedly stolen.This gave rise to numerous conjectures and alleged scenarios of events.
